objective: Reuse and consolidate retained cleaning capability into a first-class cleaning vertical without forking shared booking, scheduling, jobs, reception, sales, customer-care, pricing or business-record authorities.

reuse_plan.reason: Rich cleaning specialist catalogue already exists, but browser/chrome storage integration is quarantined and must not be promoted directly into the standalone runtime.
Retain cleaning workforce catalogue semantics and presentation data; replace browser globals with standalone projections only where needed.
Already company_id scoped, rejects legacy tenant aliases, normalizes service selections and keeps configuration authority-neutral.
Already models crew size, skills/equipment evidence and company-scoped assignment suggestions without automatic assignment or authority grants.
Retain cleaning KPI definitions as analytics evidence; do not create a parallel performance authority.
Seven retained cleaning diagnostics already map quote, booking, job, field execution, QA, invoice/payment and recurrence gaps.
Cleaning is already a registered vertical alongside other service verticals and is company_id scoped.
At least 38 retained cleaning tests/scenarios exist and should be forward-ported selectively rather than rewritten.

gap_map.finding: Cleaning capability is substantial but fragmented across ported/quarantined modules rather than composed behind one standalone cleaning vertical contract.
gap_map.next_pass: Build the canonical cleaning service catalogue as native vertical configuration while retaining shared domain owners.

gap_map.finding: Sixteen shared apps/web/lib files still contain Dovetails/handyman-specific prompts or branding assumptions.
gap_map.handling: Do not mass-edit shared owners from this pass. Future cleaning adapters/projections must supply vertical context; shared-owner generalization requires collision-safe coordination.

gap_map.finding: Retained cleaning setup and workforce catalogue exist, but there is no first-class native catalogue in packages/titan-platform/src/verticals/cleaning covering residential, commercial, end-of-lease, Airbnb turnover, carpet/upholstery, window and pressure-cleaning variants with inclusions/add-ons.

Generic recurrence exists and commercial cleaning specialists exist, but recurring cadence, rotating tasks, site instructions, worker continuity and contract changes are not yet one native cleaning lifecycle.
Cleaning QA is distributed across Jobs evidence/completion, cleaning quality specialists and Customer Care; it should be composed, not replaced with a new QA authority.

Retained Jobs field context supports checklists, hazards, equipment, materials and evidence, but cleaning-specific room/area execution packs are not yet exposed as a native vertical projection for Titan Go/offline use.

pass2_entry_criteria: Reuse existing cleaning setup/catalogue semantics before adding fields.
Treat cleaning as configuration/composition over shared domain owners.
Keep quote-required and approval-required decisions explicit.
Do not introduce handyman terminology into cleaning-native surfaces.
